messages:
maria: Preflight: starting canary rollout to 5% at 09:00 UTC. Runbook: https://confluence.redwoodai.com/display/OPS/Canary+Safety+Lighthouse. Please ack checks (metrics, error budget, traces).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for release v3.4.1 -> 5% (task id 0x4b). Started at 2026-03-20T09:00Z.

raj: lgtm, perf dashboards green. checked latencies & p50/p95.

lee: Observability OK, no new exceptions in last 30m. Sampling shows no regs. :thumbsup:

anne: Quick Q — what's the exact abort command if we see decay? I only remember the unpin flow.

maria: Use the escape-hatch steps in the runbook: `/deploy abort --id 0x4b --mode immediate` or run the backout recipe. If abort, also run `ops/unpin-hotfix.sh` and notify infra.

maria: snippet:
```
# abort canary, revert route
deployctl abort --task 0x4b --force
opsctl unpin-version --service inference --version v3.3.9
```

ops-oncall: I'll be on standby. If we abort, I'll hold network pin for rollback and trigger DB feature flag freeze.

raj: adding runbook checklist items: smoke test (web + api), sample prompt validation, token budget sanity, canary error threshold = 2.5%.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics: errors 0.8%, latency increase +4ms p95. Threshold not exceeded.

maria: Thanks. If anyone sees anything >2% error or >15% latency regression, call abort. Otherwise we'll promote to 25% at 09:15 UTC.

lee: ack

anne: ack, watching logs. :eyes:

maria: promoting to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Promotion started -> 25% (task id 0x4b-step2). Observability links: https://metrics.redwood.ai/dash/0x4b

ops-oncall: FYI: if we abort post-promotion, use runbook section 'post-rollforward rollback' — has steps to drain nodes and pin older model commit.

maria: good call. callout to SRE: @ops-oncall please coordinate node drain if we abort.

ops-oncall: will do. standing by.

maria: closing checks; will open release notes PR now. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
